title: Orchard Crawl
tagline: Numbered apples, hungry neighbours, a burrow to crawl home to.
teaser: A glowing worm in an orchard of numbered apples: each number feeds you that much, and each bite scores all the growing still to come. Eat the harvest, then crawl home to your burrow past your own tail, the wasps and the gardener. Eight orchards, three stars each, an almanac and a Daily Orchard.

manPage.synopsis: orchard crawl — eat numbered apples, chain the bites, and crawl home to your burrow before anything in the orchard stops you.
manPage.description: The owner's earlier fancy-web port of worm: the 1980 rules on a glowing 30 by 20 grid, a number on every apple, growth by that number and a score of all the growing still to come; then a full orchard with a frog, a thief bird, wasps from spoiled apples, a rival worm and a gardener. Around it, a season of eight orchards, each bringing in one of them: eat the harvest, the burrow opens, crawl in. Three stars an orchard, an almanac drawn by the game itself, records, a Daily Orchard, challenges (fill the board, King Drift's zigzags, exact lengths, numbers in order and more), and the port's own free play. A second interpretation beside the collection's own worm.

howToPlay: Steer with W A S D or the arrows; the worm keeps crawling and crashes into edges, fences and itself.
An apple's number is how much you grow; each bite scores all the growing still to come, so chain them.
Eat the harvest and your burrow opens: crawl in to come home safe and clear the orchard. Esc pauses.
